notes: Observed native sound dispatcher targets. This supplies recompilation coverage only; the real ROM still installs vectors into RAM. Boundary-timed execution is not exact bus-phase timing.

seeds.name: observed_scsp_level2_handler
seeds.provenance: Actual SCSP IRQ entry reached this program-ROM target after 1406 SCSP writes. A traced ROM instruction at 0x60020e wrote vector words 0x0060 and 0x26f6 into RAM 0x68/0x6a. No RAM vector image, game instruction or return value is substituted.

seeds.name: observed_scsp_level1_handler
seeds.provenance: Actual second SCSP IRQ entry reached this program-ROM target. The same real ROM copy instruction installed vector words 0x0060/0x068e into RAM 0x64/0x66; vector-store evidence is shared with the level-2 seed. This entry adds coverage without replacing the vector copy or game state.
